## Weights and sample composition by mode

```{r rv1-weights}
# Raking targets = weighted margins of the full sample (n = 2004)
rake_targets <- rbindlist(lapply(names(targets), function(v)
  targets[[v]][, .(variable = lbl(v), level = as.character(get(v)),
                   `share %` = round(Freq / sum(Freq) * 100, 1))]))
print(rake_targets)

# Analytic sample (gesamt), first imputed dataset
d1 <- prep(res_moderate$imp$raked[[1]], "gesamt")
kish <- function(w) round(sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2), 0)   # effective sample size
w_diag <- d1[, .(n = .N,
                 `n eff. base`  = kish(ctrl_weight),
                 `n eff. raked` = kish(ctrl_weight_raked),
                 `n eff. unit`  = kish(w_unit),
                 `weighted share % (raked)` = round(sum(ctrl_weight_raked) / sum(d1$ctrl_weight_raked) * 100, 1),
                 `weighted share % (unit)`  = round(sum(w_unit) / sum(d1$w_unit) * 100, 1)),
             by = .(mode = ctrl_method)]
print(w_diag)

# Composition by mode: unweighted, base weight, raked weight (observed values)
comp_vars <- c("ih_dem_agebr", "ih_dem_gender", "ih_dem_migration", "ih_st_education",
               "ih_st_employment", "ih_lc_hhcomp", "ih_lc_urban", "ih_lc_health")
cd <- prep(md[!is.na(fies_cat_gesamt)], "gesamt")
cd[, w_raked := d1[match(cd$id, d1$id), ctrl_weight_raked]]
comp_by_mode <- rbindlist(lapply(comp_vars, function(v) {
  x <- cd[!is.na(get(v)), .(n = .N, w_base = sum(ctrl_weight), w_rk = sum(w_raked)),
          by = .(mode = ctrl_method, level = as.character(get(v)))]
  x[, `:=`(unweighted = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
           base       = round(w_base / sum(w_base) * 100, 1),
           raked      = round(w_rk / sum(w_rk) * 100, 1)), by = mode]
  x[, variable := lbl(v)][]
}))
comp_by_mode <- dcast(comp_by_mode, variable + level ~ mode,
                      value.var = c("unweighted", "base", "raked"))
print(comp_by_mode)
```

## Missing FIES items and the 180 exclusions

```{r rv1-fies-missing}
# Exclusion rule as applied in the FAO chunks: a respondent with at least one
# missing FIES item ("weiß nicht" / "keine Angabe") has no raw score and is
# excluded (FAO 2016); respondents without household size are dropped as well.
fies_items <- paste0("f9_", 1:8)
is_miss <- function(x) { x <- as.numeric(x); is.na(x) | x > 2 }
fm <- dt[, .(id, mode = r_methode, hsize)]
fm[, n_missing := rowSums(dt[, lapply(.SD, is_miss), .SDcols = fies_items])]
fm[, excluded := n_missing > 0 | is.na(hsize)]
# check: must reproduce the FIES analytic sample
print(table(excluded = fm$excluded, fies_missing = is.na(dt$fies_cat_gesamt)))

fies_missing_by_mode <- fm[, .(n = .N,
                               `>= 1 item missing` = sum(n_missing > 0),
                               `household size missing only` = sum(n_missing == 0 & is.na(hsize)),
                               excluded = sum(excluded),
                               `excluded %` = round(mean(excluded) * 100, 1)), by = mode]
print(fies_missing_by_mode)

# Missing per item and mode
fies_item_missing <- dt[, lapply(.SD, function(x) sum(is_miss(x))), by = .(mode = r_methode),
                        .SDcols = fies_items]
print(fies_item_missing)

# Number of missing items among excluded respondents
print(dcast(fm[n_missing > 0, .N, by = .(mode, n_missing)], n_missing ~ mode,
            value.var = "N", fill = 0))

# Excluded vs retained respondents (institute base weight; design-based chi-square)
ex <- prep(md, "gesamt")
ex[, excluded := as.integer(is.na(fies_cat_gesamt))]
ex[, w_base := dt[match(ex$id, dt$id), weight]]
excl_compare <- rbindlist(lapply(c("ctrl_method", comp_vars), function(v) {
  dd  <- ex[!is.na(get(v))]
  des <- svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~w_base, data = dd)
  p   <- tryCatch(as.numeric(svychisq(as.formula(paste0("~excluded + ", v)), des)$p.value),
                  error = function(e) NA_real_)
  tab <- dd[, .(w = sum(w_base)), by = .(excluded, level = as.character(get(v)))]
  tab[, share := round(w / sum(w) * 100, 1), by = excluded]
  tab <- dcast(tab, level ~ excluded, value.var = "share")
  setnames(tab, c("0", "1"), c("retained %", "excluded %"), skip_absent = TRUE)
  tab[, `:=`(variable = lbl(v), `p (chi2)` = fmt_pval3(p))]
  setcolorder(tab, "variable")[]
}), fill = TRUE)
print(excl_compare)
```

## FI-specific module coverage (programming error)

```{r rv1-module-coverage}
# Survey rule: the FI-specific module was shown to respondents affirming at least
# one FIES item. Received = f14 answered (same definition as descr_sample).
FIELD_DATE_VAR <- NULL   # set to the interview-date column of dt, if available

mc <- md[, .(id, mode = as.character(ctrl_method), fies_low, fies_cat_gesamt,
             ih_dem_agebr, ih_dem_gender, ih_st_education, ih_st_employment)]
mc[, received := !is.na(dt[match(mc$id, dt$id), f14])]

module_cov <- rbind(
  mc[fies_low == TRUE, .(group = "eligible (>= 1 item affirmed)", eligible = .N, received = sum(received)), by = mode],
  mc[fies_cat_gesamt == "moderate", .(group = "moderate/severe", eligible = .N, received = sum(received)), by = mode])
module_cov <- rbind(module_cov,
                    module_cov[, .(mode = "total", eligible = sum(eligible), received = sum(received)), by = group])
module_cov[, missing := eligible - received]
setcolorder(module_cov, c("group", "mode"))
print(module_cov[order(group, mode)])

# Who did not receive it (moderate/severe)?
mm <- mc[fies_cat_gesamt == "moderate"]
missed_compare <- rbindlist(lapply(c("mode", "ih_dem_agebr", "ih_dem_gender",
                                     "ih_st_education", "ih_st_employment"), function(v) {
  x <- mm[!is.na(get(v)), .(n = .N, missed = sum(!received)), by = .(level = as.character(get(v)))]
  x[, `:=`(variable = lbl(v), `missed %` = round(missed / n * 100, 1))]
  x[, p_fisher := fmt_pval3(tryCatch(fisher.test(table(mm[[v]], mm$received))$p.value,
                                     error = function(e) NA_real_))]
  setcolorder(x, "variable")[]
}))
print(missed_compare)

if (!is.null(FIELD_DATE_VAR)) {
  mm[, field_date := dt[match(mm$id, dt$id), get(FIELD_DATE_VAR)]]
  print(mm[, .(n = .N, missed = sum(!received)), by = .(week = format(as.Date(field_date), "%Y-%V"))][order(week)])
}
```

## Sensitivity of the pooled prevalence

```{r rv1-sensitivity}
# Moderate+severe prevalence (Rasch posterior, pooled calibration) under
# alternative weights and mode compositions. The outcome is not imputed; values
# are averaged over the imputed datasets (raking differs slightly between them).
d_list <- lapply(res_moderate$imp$raked, prep, mode = "gesamt")
prev_w <- function(d, w) d[, sum(p_ms * get(w)) / sum(get(w)) * 100]
trim_w <- function(w) pmin(pmax(w, quantile(w, .01)), quantile(w, .99))

sens <- rbindlist(lapply(d_list, function(d) {
  d <- copy(d)
  d[, `:=`(w_one       = 1,
           w_base_unit = unit_weight(ctrl_weight, ctrl_hsize, ctrl_nadults),
           w_unit_trim = trim_w(w_unit))]
  p_on <- d[ctrl_method == "online", sum(p_ms * w_unit) / sum(w_unit)]
  p_ph <- d[ctrl_method == "phone",  sum(p_ms * w_unit) / sum(w_unit)]
  s_on <- d[, sum(w_unit[ctrl_method == "online"]) / sum(w_unit)]
  data.table(
    variant = c("unweighted", "base weight", "base weight x unit",
                "raked (respondents)", "raked x unit (main)", "raked x unit, trimmed 1%/99%",
                "online only", "phone only",
                "online share = realised", "online share = 30%",
                "online share = 50%", "online share = 70%"),
    prevalence = c(prev_w(d, "w_one"), prev_w(d, "ctrl_weight"), prev_w(d, "w_base_unit"),
                   prev_w(d, "ctrl_weight_raked"), prev_w(d, "w_unit"), prev_w(d, "w_unit_trim"),
                   p_on * 100, p_ph * 100,
                   (s_on * p_on + (1 - s_on) * p_ph) * 100,
                   (.3 * p_on + .7 * p_ph) * 100,
                   (.5 * p_on + .5 * p_ph) * 100,
                   (.7 * p_on + .3 * p_ph) * 100),
    online_share = s_on)
}))
cat("Realised weighted online share (unit weights):",
    round(mean(sens$online_share) * 100, 1), "%\n")
sens <- sens[, .(`prevalence %` = round(mean(prevalence), 1)), by = variant]

# Mode-specific Rasch calibration (separate FIES models per mode). The mode
# samples are raked to the full-sample margins, i.e. to a common composition.
sep_cal <- rbindlist(lapply(c("online", "telefon"), function(m) {
  dl <- lapply(mode_res[[m]]$imp$raked, prep, mode = m)
  data.table(variant = paste0(m, " only, mode-specific calibration"),
             `prevalence %` = round(mean(sapply(dl, prev_w, w = "w_unit")), 1))
}))
sens <- rbind(sens, sep_cal)
print(sens)

# Main estimate and mode-specific estimates with 95% CI (pooled calibration)
des_unit <- lapply(d_list, function(d) svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~w_unit, data = d))
main_ci  <- prev_total(des_unit)
mode_ci  <- prev_by_level("ctrl_method", des_unit)
print(main_ci); print(mode_ci)
```

## Gradient concordance across modes

```{r rv1-gradients}
# IH-adjusted PPCs estimated separately in the online and phone samples
# (mode-specific calibration). Same sign = gradient points the same way.
grad_tab <- function(m) {
  x <- as.data.table(lund_out[[m]]$t2)
  x[!`PPC adj. IH` %in% c("", "(ref)"),
    .(.var, level = trimws(`Factor & dimension`), prev = `Prevalence % [CI 95%]`, ppc = `PPC adj. IH`)]
}
num1 <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub(" .*", "", x)))
grad <- merge(grad_tab("online"), grad_tab("telefon"), by = c(".var", "level"),
              suffixes = c(" online", " phone"), sort = FALSE)
grad[, factor := vapply(.var, lbl, character(1))]
grad[, `same sign` := sign(num1(`ppc online`)) == sign(num1(`ppc phone`))]
grad <- grad[, .(factor, level, `prev online`, `ppc online`, `prev phone`, `ppc phone`, `same sign`)]
print(grad)
cat("Same sign:", grad[, sum(`same sign`, na.rm = TRUE)], "of", nrow(grad), "contrasts\n")
```

## Imputation diagnostics

```{r rv1-imputation}
imp_m <- res_moderate$imp$mids
imp_info <- data.table(variable  = names(res_moderate$imp$n_miss),
                       n_missing = as.integer(res_moderate$imp$n_miss))
imp_info[, `missing %` := round(n_missing / nrow(imp_m$data) * 100, 1)]
imp_info[, method := res_moderate$imp$method[variable]]
imp_info[method == "" & n_missing > 0, method := "not imputed"]
imp_info[, label := vapply(variable, lbl, character(1))]
print(imp_info[n_missing > 0 | variable %in% c("fies_binary", "ctrl_weight", "ctrl_method")])
cat("m =", imp_m$m, "| iterations =", imp_m$iteration,
    "| predictors: all variables in imp_vars (incl. FIES category, base weight,",
    "federal state and survey method), id excluded\n")

# Trace plots (convergence)
png(file.path(DIR_APP, "imputation_traceplots_%02d.png"), width = 2000, height = 2400, res = 200)
print(plot(imp_m))
dev.off()

# Observed vs imputed values
imp_cmp <- rbindlist(lapply(imp_info[n_missing > 0 & !method %in% c("", "not imputed"), variable], function(v) {
  obs <- imp_m$data[[v]][!is.na(imp_m$data[[v]])]
  iv  <- unlist(lapply(imp_m$imp[[v]], as.character))
  if (is.numeric(obs) && uniqueN(obs) > 2) {
    data.table(variable = lbl(v), level = "mean",
               observed = round(mean(obs), 2), imputed = round(mean(as.numeric(iv)), 2))
  } else {
    lv <- sort(unique(as.character(obs)))
    data.table(variable = lbl(v), level = lv,
               observed = round(as.numeric(prop.table(table(factor(as.character(obs), lv)))) * 100, 1),
               imputed  = round(as.numeric(prop.table(table(factor(iv, lv)))) * 100, 1))
  }
}))
print(imp_cmp)

num_vars <- imp_info[n_missing > 0 & !method %in% c("", "not imputed") &
                     variable %in% c("ih_dem_age", "com_walk_dist"), variable]
if (length(num_vars)) {
  png(file.path(DIR_APP, "imputation_density.png"), width = 2000, height = 1000, res = 200)
  print(tryCatch(lattice::densityplot(imp_m, as.formula(paste("~", paste(num_vars, collapse = " + ")))),
                 error = function(e) NULL))
  dev.off()
}
```

## Pairwise correlations of social and provisioning items

```{r rv1-tetrachoric}
tc_vars <- c(SOCIAL, PROVISIONING)
tc_d <- prep(md[!is.na(fies_cat_gesamt)], "gesamt")
tc <- tryCatch(psych::tetrachoric(as.data.frame(tc_d[, ..tc_vars]),
                                  weight = tc_d$ctrl_weight, na.rm = TRUE)$rho,
               error = function(e) psych::tetrachoric(as.data.frame(tc_d[, ..tc_vars]), na.rm = TRUE)$rho)
tc_tab <- data.table(item = vapply(rownames(tc), lbl, character(1)), round(tc, 2))
setnames(tc_tab, c("item", vapply(colnames(tc), lbl, character(1))))
print(tc_tab)
```

## Export

```{r rv1-export}
rv1_tables <- c(
  list("Raking targets (weighted margins of the full sample, n = 2004)" = rake_targets,
       "Weights by survey mode: effective sample sizes and weighted mode shares" = w_diag,
       "Sample composition by survey mode (%; unweighted, base weight, raked weight)" = comp_by_mode,
       "Excluded respondents by survey mode (incomplete FIES or missing household size)" = fies_missing_by_mode,
       "Missing FIES responses by item and survey mode" = fies_item_missing,
       "Excluded vs retained respondents (base-weighted %, design-based chi-square)" = excl_compare,
       "FI-specific module: eligible vs received" = module_cov,
       "Moderate/severe respondents without the FI-specific module" = missed_compare,
       "Sensitivity of the pooled prevalence (moderate+severe, %)" = sens,
       "IH-adjusted gradients estimated separately by survey mode" = grad,
       "Imputation: missingness and method per variable" =
         imp_info[n_missing > 0, .(variable = label, n_missing, `missing %`, method)],
       "Imputation: observed vs imputed values" = imp_cmp,
       "Tetrachoric correlations of social and provisioning items (base weight)" = tc_tab),
  setNames(rasch_tabs, paste0("Rasch item parameters and fit - ", names(rasch_tabs),
                              " (shares relative to the mode-specific validation sample)")))

doc <- new_landscape_doc()
for (k in seq_along(rv1_tables)) {
  doc <- doc |> body_add_par(names(rv1_tables)[k], style = "heading 2") |>
    body_add_flextable(make_flextable(rv1_tables[[k]]))
  if (k < length(rv1_tables)) doc <- doc |> body_add_break()
}
print(doc, target = file.path(DIR_APP, "rv1_appendix_additions.docx"))
message("Saved to: ", file.path(DIR_APP, "rv1_appendix_additions.docx"))
```
